original_card.question: Can one reproducible environment or artifact-comparison failure be repaired?
methods: Reproduce one portability failure and add a minimal cross-environment fix.
Audit one canonical-payload comparison for omitted proof-relevant fields.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Preserve immutable source hashes and proof-relevant content; a different compressed byte stream alone is not a mathematical mismatch.

first_step.inspect: Read the gzip-container reproducibility examples and distinguish frozen source bytes from regenerated payloads.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Reproduce one specific mismatch or audit one canonical comparison for omitted proof-relevant fields.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Portable exact checks prevent environment failures from blocking valid contributions.
allowed_variations: One interpreter/version mismatch or one payload field comparison.
scope_change_triggers: Removing immutable-source pins because generated compressed bytes differ.

actual_scope: Repair the #741 replay comparator so a timing exemption cannot hide a nested proof leaf or a non-numeric timing value, while gzip payload equality and nonnegative root or stage-list timing still match.
scope_change_reason: The card allows one payload-field comparison. This keeps that comparison on research/complex741-parallel-replay/compare_replays.py and repairs the timing exemption. It does not remove an immutable source pin, change a supplier, or rerun the selected cold replay.
bottleneck_link: A portable replay check that ignores a changed kappa nested under seconds can accept a non-equivalent complex supplier run. The complex side is the binding primitive, so a false replay match blocks review of a real supplier change.
stop_rule: Stop after one repaired comparison, its predecessor fixture, and the existing #741 scheduler tests. Do not run make frontier1094-verify or make complex741-parallel-verify.
evidence: PASS_REPLAY_TIMING_LEAF_EXEMPTION. The predecessor blob 6afb9d956f5012346ee16a08f94c69a63f1f453a accepts /seconds/kappa, /additional_evidence/seconds, and non-numeric timing values. The working comparator rejects those fixtures and still accepts gzip mtime differences plus nonnegative /seconds and /stages/0/seconds leaves.
author: hevlyo
ai_assistance: Substantial AI assistance was used to locate the comparison gap, draft the leaf rule, and write the fixtures and notes.

open_questions.question: Which root numeric seconds leaves in a real #741 work tree are wall-clock times, and which are proof counts that should not be exempt?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The repaired comparator still exempts every root or list-element seconds value that is a nonnegative finite number, on every JSON file. generated_identity.py drops only CLIFFORD-REVIEW.json's root seconds. A proof count stored at the root under that name would still compare as timing.
open_questions.first_step: On one saved pair of sequential and parallel #741 work trees, list every accepted timing path and the file that owns it.
open_questions.blocked_by: This checkout has no saved 304-file work tree. make complex741-parallel-verify was not run, and the historical comparison table was not rerun.
